description: Current mark/oracle/mid price, 24h volume and open interest (in coins and USD) for one or more markets. The top-markets list also shows max leverage. Leave coins empty for the top markets by 24h volume. Works for HIP-3 markets (e.g. "xyz:TSLA").

coins.description: Markets to show, e.g. ["BTC","ETH","xyz:TSLA"]. Omit for the busiest markets.

top.description: When coins is empty, how many top markets by 24h volume (default 15).

name: hydromancer_market_snapshot
title: Live price, volume and open interest for markets
